text:
samira: Quick UX sync: deciding default validation pattern for Console forms (inline vs top summary), how to show required fields, and delete confirmations. Short thread so we can land a pattern.

eli: My vote is inline-first: show field-level messages under inputs, with an error icon. Use a compact top summary only when submit returns multiple errors or server-side failures.

kai: +1. For required fields: asterisk visually, but include a screen-reader-only 'required' label. For complex controls (schema, integrations) surface a persistent 'Required' badge.

nora: Agree with sr-only + asterisk. Also recommend reserving space for helper/error text to avoid layout jumps: reserve height equal to two lines.

pm-lin: What's the rule for top summary vs inline? PM prefers minimal friction.

eli: Rule proposal: client-side single-field validation -> inline. Submit with >=2 errors OR server-side errors -> show top summary with anchors to fields. Server errors should surface actionable copy.

kai: Deletion UX: ops wants typed-confirm everywhere. Design argues that's heavy. Proposal: tiered confirms: typed-confirm for resources tagged 'prod' or > 50 users; checkbox+warning for others; optional 3s countdown for mid-risk items.

samira: I like tiered confirms. For typed-confirm require exact phrase including resource short name. Truncate long names visually but include full name in aria.

nora: Accessibility checklist: link inline error with aria-describedby; summary region use role="alert" and aria-live="assertive" for blocking submits; set aria-atomic="true" for consistent announcements; icons must be aria-hidden and use text for SRs.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: ensure asterisk contrast >= 4.5:1 and provide non-color affordance (icon/badge). For typed-confirm inputs set autocomplete="off" and aria-label that includes explanation.

pm-lin: Telemetry question: what should we capture to evaluate defaults?

kai: Capture confirm_type (none|checkbox|countdown|typed), delete_context (prod|non-prod), and validation_mode (inline|summary|hybrid). Also log whether undo was used.

eli: Microcopy examples:
- Bad: "Invalid"
- Good: "Email — enter a valid email address."
- Server duplicate: "Project name already used — choose a different name or append a suffix."

samira: Small UI nit: for inputs with helper + error, swap helper to hidden when error shown or keep reserved space to avoid page shift. Prefer reserved space.

nora: E2E + a11y tests: SR announces inline error on submit, summary anchors focus to first error, typed-confirm exact-match enforced, countdown obeys prefers-reduced-motion, cancel returns focus.

pm-lin: Action items: samira -> update Figma with inline + summary variants and three confirm flows; eli -> draft microcopy for top 12 form fields; kai -> telemetry + rollout gating; nora -> a11y checklist + sample implementation notes. I'll schedule a 15min review after mocks land.

samira: Thanks! Will ping when prototypes are ready. :sparkles:
